shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Cards at rest (light mode). Places the surface on the page without drama.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, sheets, popovers. Signals above-the-page elevation.

shadows.name: ambient-dark
shadows.purpose: Cards at rest (dark mode). Higher opacity to compensate for compressed lightness range.

motion.name: ease-out-fast
motion.purpose: Elements entering the screen (dropdown open, sheet reveal). 200ms.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Font size drops from 18px to 16px; h1 from 56px to 36px.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action trigger. Carbon background, white text. Use for the one primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background-color: #1c1c1c; color: #ffffff; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #2e2e2e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1c1c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent, bordered. Used alongside a primary button or alone for low-urgency actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background-color: transparent; color: #08060d; border: 1px solid #e5e4e7; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.05); border-color: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.25); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1c1c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { background-color: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.08); } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Invisible at rest. For low-prominence actions that must not compete with content.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; background-color: transparent; color: #6b6375; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.05); color: #08060d; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1c1c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The primary data container. Always carries a border and ambient shadow. Never nest cards.
components.html:
Historico por produto

Selecione um produto para ver seu historico.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e4e7; background-color: #ffffff; color: #08060d; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { padding: 24px 24px 0 24px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.18; letter-spacing: -0.24px; color: #08060d; } .ds-card-content { padding: 16px 24px 24px 24px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field. Same silhouette as outline button — editability is consistent across form elements.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 40px; width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e5e4e7; background-color: #ffffff; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #08060d; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6375; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1c1c1c; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; background-color: #f5f5f5; }

components.name: Nav Item (default)
components.description: Sidebar navigation item at rest. Quiet by default; only the active state is Carbon.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #6b6375; background: transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background-color: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.05); color: #08060d; }

components.name: Nav Item (active)
components.description: Active sidebar navigation item. Carbon background, white text. The only nav element that uses Carbon as background fill.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #ffffff; background: #1c1c1c; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview:
This design language has one job: make the facts visible. No visual persuasion. No crafted urgency. No metric theater. This is a tool for checking what happened to prices — not for convincing anyone of anything, not for celebrating savings, not for manufacturing concern. The chart shows the curve. The curve is the answer.

The palette runs from Ink Night to Page White with a single near-black accent — Carbon — reserved for interactive elements only. Typography is one family (Inter Variable) across a clear four-step scale; hierarchy comes from size and weight, not decoration. Components are solid: gently rounded, bordered with a quiet edge, carrying a soft ambient shadow that places them on the page without lifting them above it. The one chromatic indulgence is deliberate: the chart line and its points are blue — Data Sky and Data Deep — the only hue in the system, applied exactly where the data lives.

Anti-references are load-bearing here. No neon accents (the crypto tell). No rainbow progress rings (the Mint/YNAB tell). No gradient heroes or social proof rows (the SaaS template tell). If any of those appeared, the signal would be: 'this app is trying to sell you something.' It is not. It is telling you prices.
keyCharacteristics: Single sans-serif family; hierarchy through scale and weight, not color or decoration
One near-black accent (Carbon), used only for interactive elements; its restraint signals action
Two data colors (blues), applied only in the chart; blue elsewhere collapses the system's one expressive signal
Light surface as default; system dark mode via prefers-color-scheme; ambient shadow on cards only
Portuguese UI copy; WCAG AA target; chart data accessible through non-color encoding

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Carbon is the only accent. It appears on buttons, focus rings, and active nav states — nothing else. Its rarity is the point: when Carbon appears, something responds to the user. Decorative use collapses the system's only clear affordance signal.

rules.name: The Two Blues Rule
rules.body: Data Sky and Data Deep appear only in the chart. Introducing blue anywhere else — links, headers, labels, illustrations — destroys the one visual distinction that says 'this is the data.'

rules.name: The One Size Jump Rule
rules.body: Adjacent typographic elements must differ by at least 1.25× in size. Flat scales — 16/18/20px — read as noise, not hierarchy. If the difference cannot be felt at a glance, merge the levels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Only cards and floating panels carry shadows. Buttons, inputs, nav items, labels, and decorative elements are flat. Shadow on anything that does not need to sit above something else is decoration — and decoration is prohibited here.

dos: Use Carbon (#1c1c1c) only for interactive affordances: buttons, focus rings, active nav. When Carbon appears, it means: act here.
Keep Data Sky and Data Deep strictly inside the chart. Blue means data; blue elsewhere destroys that meaning.
Apply ambient shadow to all card surfaces in light mode. A shadowless card on a white page disappears.
Vary spacing for rhythm: 48px between major sections, 24px within cards, 8px between inline elements. Uniform padding everywhere is monotony.
Write UI copy in Portuguese. The interface is for Portuguese speakers; mixing languages signals inconsistency.
Provide accessible chart alternatives: ARIA labels, and at least one non-color encoding for the price trend.
Cap body text line length at 65–70ch on any text-heavy surface.
donts: Don't use neon accents, glow effects, or saturated bright colors anywhere outside the chart.
Don't add rainbow progress rings, gamified achievement indicators, or color-coded budget status.
Don't build a gradient hero, feature grid, or social proof row on any surface.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent).
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient fill for decorative type effects.
Don't add shadow to buttons, inputs, nav items, or labels.
Don't introduce a second typeface. Inter Variable covers the full hierarchy.
